description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to the house, replacement of the front garden boundary treatment and installation of a front cycle/ waste store and an air source heat pump.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (D(2)01 (Rev B); D(2)02 (Rev B)  Received:  25 April 2022; D(I)05 (Rev C); D(I)08 (Rev C)  Received:  23 March 2022; D(I)03; Unreferenced Location Plan  Received:  28 February 2022; Techical statements: Daikin Altherma 3M (E(B/D)LA-D series) Received:  25 April 2022; Planning Fire Safety Strategy  Received:  28 February 2022.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the single storey rear infill and rear extension hereby approved shall match those used in the existing house.  

The proposed front cycle and waste stores shall be constructed/ clad with high quality timber, aluminium or brick only.
Condition : 5 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey rear infill and rear extension hereby approved.

Condition : 6 - a) The cumulative measured or calculated rating level of noise emitted from the air source heat pump to be positioned in the house's front yard area hereby approved, shall be 10dB(A) below the existing background noise level, at all times that the mechanical system operates.  The measured or calculated noise levels shall be determined at the boundary of the nearest ground floor noise sensitive premises or one meter from the facade of the nearest first floor (or higher) noise sensitive premises, and in accordance to the latest British Standard 4142.  An alternative position for assessmen/ measurement may be used to allow ease of access, this must be shown on a map and noise propagation calculations detailed to show how the design criteria is achieved.  

b) The air source heat pump plant shall be isolated on adequate proprietary anti-vibration mounts to prevent the structural transmission of vibration and regenerated noise within adjacent or adjoining premises, and these shall be so maintained thereafter.  

c) Following installation of the air source heat pump equipment hereby approved, a post completion noise assessment shall be submitted for review and approval in writing by the Local Planning Authority which demonstrates the actual measures rating level of the mechanical plant operating under normal conditions.  All measurements shall be made in accordance with the methodology of BS4142:  2014 (Methods for rating and assessing industrial and commercial sound) and/ or its subsequent amendments.  The post completion report shall be both completed and submitted to the Local Planning Authority within 28 days of completion of the air source heat pump's installation.
